tldr: 台股11月3日崩跌3.59%、1,612.60點收43,307.54點，創史上第7大單日點數跌幅，全球AI科技股賣壓重創晶片股。
外資單日賣超1,073.1億元、新台幣走弱，費城半導體指數近一個月跌21.35%、台積電ADR下跌15.68%。
官員認為屬情緒性修正：台積電第三季獲利仍增68.7%、在手訂單續增；高資產銀行客戶突破3.2萬戶、主動式ETF規模逼近兆元。

items.title_zh: 台股重挫1,612點、寫史上第7大單日點數跌幅
items.title_en: TAIEX suffers 7th-steepest point drop, diving 3.59% in global tech sell-off
items.summary_zh: 加權指數11月3日(週二)崩跌1,612.60點、跌幅3.59%，收43,307.54點，創史上第7大單日點數跌幅，全球AI與科技股賣壓重創以晶片為主的台股。此跌勢延續前一週五逾1,156點的重挫，使指數明顯回落於10月底高點之下，凸顯台股對美國科技股情緒及AI資本支出回報疑慮的高度連動與脆弱，市場觀望氣氛轉濃。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX plunged 1,612.60 points, or 3.59 percent, on Tuesday, Nov. 3 to close at 43,307.54, its seventh-steepest single-day point decline on record, as a worldwide sell-off in AI and technology shares battered the island's chip-heavy market. The slide extended losses from the prior Friday's 1,156-point drop, pulling the index sharply off its late-October highs and underscoring how exposed Taiwan equities remain to swings in US tech sentiment and worries over AI capital-spending returns.

items.title_zh: 外資單日倒貨1,073億 台幣走貶加劇科技股殺盤
items.title_en: Foreign investors dump NT$107bn as weak NT dollar compounds tech rout
items.summary_zh: 外資11月3日於集中市場賣超新台幣1,073.1億元，台股大跌3.59%之際新台幣同步走弱。費城半導體指數近一個月重挫21.35%、台積電ADR下跌15.68%，加深資金外流壓力；光是10月外資淨賣超即約9,943億元，顯示海外持續調節與匯率走弱正相互強化，壓抑台股後市表現。
items.summary_en: Foreign institutional investors sold a net NT$107.31 billion of Taiwanese shares on the main board Tuesday as the TAIEX's 3.59 percent fall coincided with a softer New Taiwan dollar. The PHLX Semiconductor Index has tumbled 21.35 percent over the past month and TSMC's US-listed ADRs have slumped 15.68 percent, feeding the outflows. October alone saw foreign net sales of about NT$994.3 billion, highlighting how sustained overseas selling and currency weakness are reinforcing one another.

items.title_zh: 國發會主委：AI支出疑慮僅短暫衝擊台股
items.title_en: NDC head says AI-spending jitters to rattle TAIEX only briefly
items.summary_zh: 國發會主委在科技股領跌重挫後出面喊話，強調此波賣壓反映的是投資人對AI資本支出回報的情緒，而非企業基本面轉壞，對台股衝擊應屬短期。官員指出，台灣硬體廠商的在手訂單仍相當強勁，預期到明年底前將持續成長，顯示即便市場動盪，以AI為核心的出口動能依然穩固，無需過度悲觀。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's National Development Council minister sought to calm markets after the tech-led plunge, saying the sell-off reflects investor sentiment over AI capital-expenditure returns rather than any deterioration in corporate fundamentals, and that the hit to local shares should be short-lived. Officials pointed to still-robust order backlogs at Taiwan's hardware makers, expected to keep growing through the end of next year, as evidence the island's AI-driven export engine remains intact despite the turbulence.

items.title_zh: 社論：科技股修正源於AI回報焦慮、非基本面崩壞
items.title_en: Editorial: tech sell-off reflects AI-return anxiety, not broken fundamentals
items.summary_zh: 《台北時報》社論指出，台股晶片股急挫主因在於市場憂慮龐大AI基礎建設投資能否回收，而非企業獲利基礎惡化。文章強調台積電基本面依舊強勁，第三季稅後純益年增68.7%，並已上修2026年營收成長預估，顯示此波回檔屬對偏高評價的情緒性重新定價，而非先進晶片需求降溫的訊號。
items.summary_en: A Taipei Times editorial argued the sharp retreat in Taiwan's chip stocks stems from anxiety over whether heavy AI infrastructure spending will pay off, rather than any erosion in the underlying earnings story. It noted TSMC's fundamentals remain strong—third-quarter net profit jumped 68.7 percent year-on-year and the foundry has lifted its 2026 revenue-growth guidance—suggesting the correction is a sentiment-driven repricing of lofty valuations rather than a signal of fading demand for advanced chips.

items.title_zh: 高資產銀行客戶突破3.2萬 金管會財管專案見效
items.title_en: High-asset bank clients top 32,000 as FSC wealth push gains traction
items.summary_zh: 金管會表示，截至9月底國內銀行服務資產逾新台幣1億元的客戶達32,326戶，單月增加1,730戶，目前已有25家銀行獲准承作高資產財管業務。此類客戶資產中，共同基金占17.6%、保險商品占13.6%，顯示主管機關推動本國高資產財富管理市場的政策逐步奏效，持續將富人資金導入由本地機構管理的金融商品。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's banks served 32,326 clients holding more than NT$100 million each at the end of September, up 1,730 from a month earlier, the Financial Supervisory Commission said, with 25 banks now approved to offer high-asset wealth management. Mutual funds made up 17.6 percent of these clients' assets and insurance products 13.6 percent, showing how the regulator's drive to build a domestic high-net-worth banking market is steadily channelling wealthy Taiwanese money into locally managed products.

items.title_zh: 金控海外曝險創高 匯率與美國風險牽動金融業
items.title_en: Record overseas exposure leaves financial firms sensitive to FX, US risk
items.summary_zh: 監理資料顯示，台灣金控公司海外曝險升抵新台幣31.48兆元（約9,768.8億美元）歷史新高，其中美國為最大債務國。此一高度集中，說明何以新台幣走弱（今年因外資撤離股市貶約3%）與美股劇烈波動會迅速傳導至本國銀行與壽險；在全球科技股賣壓下，其龐大的海外資產部位同時面臨匯率與評價雙重風險。
items.summary_en: Overseas exposure of Taiwan's financial holding companies hit a record NT$31.48 trillion (US$976.88 billion), with the United States the largest debtor country, regulatory data show. The concentration helps explain why a weaker New Taiwan dollar—down about 3 percent this year as foreign investors pull money from local equities—and swings in US markets ripple quickly through Taiwanese banks and insurers, whose large foreign-asset books face both currency and valuation risks as the global tech sell-off unfolds.

items.title_zh: 主動式ETF規模逼近兆元 台灣基金熱潮延燒
items.title_en: Active ETFs near NT$1 trillion as Taiwan's fund boom rolls on
items.summary_zh: 截至9月底，台灣40檔主動式ETF合計規模達新台幣9,886億元，逼近兆元大關，惟績效明顯分歧。20檔聚焦台股的主動式ETF近三個月平均報酬僅0.60%，逾半數未能繳出正報酬。資金流向上，本土業者1至5月淨流入約136億美元，外商發行的ETF則淨流出約5.9億美元，凸顯本地投資人對國產商品的偏好。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's active ETFs managed a combined NT$988.6 billion at the end of September across 40 funds, closing in on the NT$1 trillion milestone, even as performance diverged sharply. The 20 Taiwan-focused active ETFs averaged just a 0.60 percent return over three months, with fewer than half in positive territory. Domestic issuers dominated flows, pulling in about US$13.6 billion from January to May while foreign-firm ETFs saw roughly US$590 million of net outflows, underscoring local investors' appetite for homegrown products.

items.title_zh: 財富管理競逐升溫 聚焦家族辦公室與傳承
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth race heats up around family offices and succession
items.summary_zh: 截至8月底約26家銀行獲准承作高資產客戶、管理資產約新台幣3.11兆元，顧問業者看好資產委託、家族辦公室與跨世代傳承的新商機。私募基金餘額仍僅占相關資產約0.32%，金管會已承諾鬆綁上限；國泰等大型壽險規劃將旗下數兆元壽險資產移轉至資產管理子公司，政府並研議對特定家族信託給予稅務優惠，以留住高資產家族於境內布局。
items.summary_en: With around 26 banks approved to serve high-net-worth clients managing NT$3.11 trillion by late August, advisers see fresh opportunity in asset guidance, family offices and intergenerational transfer. Private-fund balances remain tiny at about 0.32 percent of those assets—a cap the FSC has pledged to ease—while big insurers such as Cathay plan to move trillions of life-insurance assets to their asset-management arms, and Taiwan weighs tax relief for certain family trusts to anchor wealthy families onshore.
